text: Five things to pack for a weekend away, and where each goes.
Time to pack the Hobo 2.0 for a weekend away. Watch where each thing goes, and which part of the bag takes care of it.
One: the things you reach for most. Phone, keys, tickets. Hidden pockets keep them easy to find, so you stop digging through the bag.
Two: the little stuff. A charger, lip balm, a notebook. Smart compartments give each one its own place, so nothing sinks to the bottom.
Three: your cards. The RFID lining blocks card scanners, and lockable zippers keep the bag shut in a crowded station.
Next: the walk to the hotel. The cut-resistant strap sits on your shoulder and leaves your hands free for the luggage.
Last: the café stop. Loop the table strap around your chair, and the bag stays right where you left it while you relax.
